node.statement: Fix an arbitrary U in calU and define S=sigma(U)=u_delta(U^dagger). Node 1.5 makes sigma globally defined and calU-valued, so S is in calU; it also puts U bold-dot S and U^dagger in S_delta. Apply node 1.4 first to X=U bold-dot S (with the unitary pair U,S), and then to X=U^dagger. Using mu(U,S)=u_delta(U bold-dot S) and sigma(U)=u_delta(U^dagger) gives ||mu(U,S)-U bold-dot S||<=84*epsilon_r and ||S-U^dagger||<=84*epsilon_r.
